drawingPresentation.description: Full Snapshot only: read effective drawing order and Instance body fill.

__schema255.description: Resolve a tap on the current draft, including earlier wires. Optional net or member restricts the intended Net; a tap joining a different crossing Net is rejected.

__schema259.description: Net ID or name; choose its nearest route to the other endpoint on the current draft.

__schema263.description: Ordered stable member IDs of this endpoint or Route. Use only one of memberId, memberIds or selectionExpression.

__schema265.description: Select existing source members by expression, preserving expansion order. Shorthand such as <3,0> requires one explicit indexed source context. This does not name Nets or widen a scalar.

oneOf.description: Opt-in, bounded one-pass placement of visible default Instance labels. Compact/collision avoidance default true. Preserve manually positioned (unless includeManual), locked and custom-styled labels, bindings and electrical names, and name those left in place (LABELS_LEFT_IN_PLACE); unresolved clashes remain observations.
A figure's label convention in one step and one undo. Nothing hidden is shown; labels arrange-labels leaves alone keep their place and look.

commands.description: Ordered atomic route-net, power rail, label, model, display, annotation move, direction, VDD mode, bulk default or terminal removal commands; one undo, no partial commit.

instances.description: A part without a reference takes the next free name, as a GUI insert does.

pinAnchors.description: By new Instance ID. Solves placement.position from this pin; preserves rotation/mirror. No implicit connection.

displays.description: By new device Instance ID: its labels from the start. Left out, the name shows alone; showValue:true shows the value given, else the catalog default (#1435).

placement.description: Origin and orientation. With pinAnchor only the orientation is read; left out, the part goes upright and unmirrored.

oneOf.description: Make Cell id the Project's default entry. Moves nothing and changes no simulation's Cell.
Give one instance its own copy of its Cell, calling the same children; the Cell's other uses keep it. One undo.
Switch instances to another Cell with the same Pin names (any case). Refuses a cycle; drops overrides the new Cell does not declare. One undo.
Put the instance's Cell parts into the target Document in its place, with its parameter values; Nets stay joined, unrouted. Other uses keep the Cell. One undo.
Move parts into a new Cell placed where they were: one Pin per Net leaving them, named after it; parent parameters they use pass through. Refuses splitting an inductor coupling. One undo.
Arrange this Cell's block Pins by name. Pins not named keep their place; callers keep their Nets and their wiring is redrawn.
Size this Cell's block body: multiples of 20 (10 inside explicit edges), at least the smallest that fits its Pins and their names. Every caller redraws it; callers keep their Nets.

Draw this Cell's block with its own artwork, or reset it (symbolMode "automatic"). artworkText: raw Symbol JSON (omitted: the current artwork). pinMap: every Cell Pin by name to {pinName} or {supply}; omitted, the current map while it fits, else same names. Callers redraw and keep their Nets and netlist.

__schema299.description: Change one part as Apply in Properties does, through the same planner: a moved part joins a pin it lands on, as a drag does.

__schema301.description: The part's Reference; for a Cell Pin, the Pin's name.

__schema305.description: A formula block's drawing; null clears a field.

__schema307.description: A block's supply Net by ID; null returns it to Auto.

__schema309.description: The Net of a terminal no pin of the part's symbol draws, by pin (a block's VDD, a substrate's B or SUB, an inductor's CT); null returns a supply to Auto and leaves another unconnected.

__schema311.description: A controlled source's control; null clears it. For a switch clocked by its label (a two-terminal switch or a chopper), the clock phase as written, e.g. Φ_1 or PHIA_bar (_bar draws an overbar); null clocks it by its own name. Its label keeps its visibility.

__schema313.description: A controlled source's outline (vccs, cccs, vcvs, ccvs): circle, the default, or diamond. Its netlist, pins and wires stay.

reflect.description: Reflect in place: y flips left-right, x top-bottom.

__schema316.description: Exact routing grid landing, not artwork contact. Unreachable positions are rejected with the nearest reachable landing.

__schema319.description: Commit a text as the canvas editor does; on a part's or Cell Pin's name label, RichText that spells the name only restyles it. A Net label takes set-net-label.

__schema325.description: Line up part origins on one coordinate (the first part's when left out).

__schema330.description: Free one pin from its Net, as its menu does. For a bus, memberId is required and detaches only that lane while preserving other connections.

__schema334.description: Mark or clear an explicit set of unused scalar pins or bus members atomically. Connected members require explicit disconnection first.

__schema338.description: Explicit selection. Includes owned displays and formal interface declarations, and, as in the GUI, a wire that only tapped a deleted part into other wiring. Select all object IDs for complete Cell deletion.

reference.description: X and a number; omit it for the next free one, as the GUI names a Cell instance.

__schema343.description: When supplied, solves the origin instead of using placement.position; keeps orientation.

target.description: Current Net ID/name, member pin, explicit pins to join, or an original import-reference Net. Routes only missing visible connections.

trunk.description: Straight horizontal/vertical trunk; otherwise use MST guidance. Atomic, not an obstacle autorouter.

__schema351.description: Move an existing Junction and reshape every incident Route atomically; preserve connectivity and respect protected geometry.

__schema355.description: The Cell's NMOS or PMOS body default, as its settings in Properties set it: bodies on the old default move to the Net; wired bodies stay.

__schema358.description: Net ID or name; null clears the default.

__schema361.description: Show text on a part's or Port's name label, or on a Net label, while the part keeps its own Reference, the Pin its name and the Net its name in the netlist, connectivity and same-name joining, e.g. an op-amp X1 drawn A1 or Net VEA_OUT drawn VEA,OUT; give exactly one of instanceId or annotationId; null shows the name again. Survives Project Code and Copy as the label's text.

__schema363.description: A part or Port, whose name label shows the text.

__schema364.description: A Net label instead of a part.

__schema367.description: Expand a signal expression onto distinct existing scalar branches in explicit routeIds order, with one atomic Label edit.

text.description: Plain text takes the label's standard look (VB1 reads V over a B1 subscript); RichText sets its own, and only restyles an existing label whose name it spells.

__schema373.description: Absolute drawing position; preserve electrical binding and object ownership.

__schema375.description: Which end of the text stands at position: start (text to its right), middle or end; omitted keeps the label's.

scope.description: Defaults to the existing Net scope, otherwise local; global must be intentional.

__schema379.description: Set a straight Power Rail's two ends on its own line. Taps and the one label stay; no pin is joined.

__schema387.description: Also re-place labels moved by hand.

__schema389.description: Side tried first; outside = away from the drawing's centre line, mirrored halves.

__schema392.description: textbook: MOS W/L hidden, other values left as they are, names in their role look (R_L, I_SS, M_1) and labels arranged as arrange-labels arranges them.

__schema393.description: Left out: every placed part of the Cell.

__schema401.description: A Cell instance in the target Document.

__schema403.description: Defaults to the source's next free number, as Amp_2.

__schema405.description: Cell instances in the target Document.

__schema406.description: Also every other use, in any Document, of the Cells those instances call.

__schema409.description: A Cell instance in the target Document.

__schema411.description: Parts of the target Document to move.

offset.description: Along the side from the Symbol origin, a multiple of 10. Left out: a Pin keeping its side stays put, one changing side takes the first free slot inside the body (0, -20, 20, …).
